question: Which of the following date is observed as World Clean Up Day?
solution:
The correct answer is __**September 15**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **World Clean Up Day **is observed annually on the **third Saturday of September**.
 
• In 2024, the third Saturday of September falls on September 15.
 
• World Clean Up Day aims to bring together people worldwide to **combat the global waste problem**.
 
• The initiative involves millions of volunteers from different countries participating in clean-up activities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **World Clean Up Day**

 
 
• World Clean Up Day was initiated by the **Let's Do It Foundation**, based in Estonia.
 
• The first World Clean Up Day took place in 2008 in Estonia, where 50,000 people came together to clean up the entire country in just five hours.
 
• It has grown into a global movement, with millions of volunteers from over 150 countries participating annually.
 
• The primary goal of World Clean Up Day is to raise awareness about the global waste problem and motivate people to take action in their communities.
 
 
 
• **Environmental Impact of Waste**
 
 
• Improper waste disposal can lead to various environmental issues, including soil and water pollution.
 
• Plastic waste, in particular, poses a significant threat to marine life and ecosystems.
 
• Reducing, reusing, and recycling are essential practices to minimize waste and its environmental impact.
 
• Participating in clean-up activities helps in reducing the amount of waste in the environment and promotes a cleaner and healthier planet.
 
 
 
• **Global Participation**
 
 
• World Clean Up Day witnesses participation from volunteers, organizations, and governments worldwide.
 
• Various events and activities are organized, including community clean-ups, waste audits, and educational programs.
 
• The movement encourages collaboration and collective action to tackle the global waste problem.
 
• It also emphasizes the importance of sustainable practices and responsible waste management.
